8560 Terene 185 or 195- BC John Bartlett

 
 
 
NUMBER:
8560
 
AUTHOR:
Terence
 (c. 185 or c. 195– B.C.)
 
QUOTATION:
Rigorous law is often rigorous injustice.
 
1
 
ATTRIBUTION:
Heautontimoroumenos. Act iv. Sc. 5, 48. (796.)
 
 
 
Note 1.
Extreme law, extreme injustice, is now become a stale proverb in discourse.—
Cicero
: 
De Officiis, i. 33.
Une extrême justice est souvent une injure (Extreme justice is often injustice.—Racine: 
Frères Ennemies, act iv. sc. 3.
Mais l’extrême justice est une extrême injure.—
Francis M. Voltaire
: 
Oe
dipus, act iii. sc. 3.
